scripts.android:doctor: npx cap doctor android && node scripts/android-build-env-check.mjs
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:copy: npm run build && npx cap copy android
scripts.android:open: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run cap:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.android:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:aab: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
